observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: indoor stage with draped blue and gold curtains and fairy lights, during a valedictory service cultural dance event
observation.formation_and_space: starts with two solo dancers entering and performing, then a large group enters in a single horizontal line across the stage, performing synchronized formations including bending, squatting, and moving in unison
observation.posture: torso leaned slightly forward with bent knees and low center of gravity throughout
observation.footwork: fast, rhythmic high-energy steps stamping on the beat, accompanied by ankle rattles; precise stepping details obscured by camera distance and stage lights
observation.arms_and_hands: arms held out to the sides or bent at elbows, holding white cloths/handkerchiefs that wave dynamically with the movement
observation.hips_and_torso: energetic hip bounces and torso shakes coordinated with the heavy percussion beats
observation.levels_jumps_turns: frequent bending down into low squat positions and rapid turns; no high aerial jumps visible
observation.costume_and_props: matching sleeveless tops with colored trim, patterned skirts, beaded necklaces, headbands, ankle rattles, and white handkerchiefs held in hands
observation.cannot_infer: exact footwork details, weight distribution, and subtle ankle articulation due to stage lighting and wide camera angle.

signature_moments.what: two solo dancers drop down into a low squat while waving white cloths
full group enters and lines up across the stage, stepping rapidly with bent knees and swaying handkerchiefs
